regions.name: Unimodal rainfall areas
regions.where: Karamoja, the north-eastern strip along the Kenya border (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: Rainy shading starts exactly at mid-March (counted, per the at-least-half rule). Main Season harvest bar runs early Aug to exactly mid-Oct. A second, unlabelled harvest bar covers all of December. Livestock migration Jan to early Apr and Sep to Dec.

regions.name: Bimodal rainfall areas
regions.where: The rest of Uganda: west, centre, east and the north outside Karamoja (purple on the locator map)
regions.notes: S2 harvest bar starts at mid-December and continues as an unlabelled bar through January at the left edge (one season, wrapping). Season 1 planting starts at mid-March, Season 2 planting ends at mid-October (both counted).

assign.method: Only four adm1 regions; Karamoja (unimodal) is a minority of Northern (and borders Eastern), so every region is mapped to bimodal; no adm2 units exist to carve out Karamoja. Reviewed 2026-10-28: Northern (UG3) moved to unimodal. Our Uganda figures are the IPC Karamoja analysis, filed under Northern, and ERA5 gives Northern a unimodal season (r 0.85 vs 0.42 bimodal). Northern outside Karamoja is bimodal on FEWS NET's map.

transcriber_notes: Edges were measured on the full-resolution image. Several edges fall exactly at mid-month (unimodal rainy start, unimodal main harvest end, bimodal S1 planting start, S2 planting end, S2 harvest start); these were counted as covering the month. The unimodal region (Karamoja) cannot be represented at adm1 because the admin file has only the four statistical regions and no adm2.
